title: Kradl - Ceiling Mount Bike Lift and Rack. Bicycle Storage Hoist Without Electricity, Clumsy Ropes or Pulleys.
features: LIFT: Kradl's Powerful Internal Spring Lifts Your Bicycle up to the Ceiling, or Anywhere in Between, Without Electricity, Batteries, Ropes, or Pulleys.

LOAD: Choose the 40lb Kradl to Hoist Heavier Bikes (Mountain Bikes, Beach Cruisers, Steel Frame Bikes) Weighing 26-40lbs. Choose the 25lb Kradl for Lighter Bikes (Road Bikes, Carbon Fiber or Aluminum Frames, Kid's Bikes) Weighing 0-25Lbs. Please Follow These Guidelines For Ease of Use (Do Not Upsize if You Have a Lighter Bike).

CEILING HEIGHTS: The 25lb Kradl has 12ft of Cable Travel and is Ideal for Ceiling Heights up to 14ft. The 40lb Model has 10ft of Cable Travel and Handles Ceilings up to 12ft. Contact Us for Special Scenarios or Requests.
INSTALLATION: Easy to Install, Requiring Just Two Included Mounting Screws. Please Watch Our Videos for Installation, Setup, and Operating Instructions.
BIKE TYPES: Compatible With All Bike Types Weighing up to 40lbs, Including Bikes with a Step-Through / Women's Frame. Use a Pair of Kradls to Support Heavier eBikes up to 80lbs.
